remaining_tasks.name: Fix Remove-handler race (Gap A) and gate banner-dismissal on a real pick (Gap B) in js/ui/settings-modal.js
E2E regression coverage for both gap fixes in tests/e2e/settings-autosave.spec.js

decisions.decision: Gap B (first-launch banner reappearing after Settings-only configuration) is closed by setting the 'autosaveBannerDismissed' flag from settings-modal.js's pickOrChange handler, not by passing isConfigured into mountTodayScreen.
decisions.rationale: js/app.js calls restoreHandle() asynchronously then calls mountTodayScreen(...) synchronously in the same tick, so autosaveState.status is still 'unset' at every mountTodayScreen call — passing isConfigured would silently fail for a folder configured in a prior session. Setting the dismissal flag from Settings sidesteps the race and touches only settings-modal.js.
